findings.title: Study 2 victim-group main effect F not exactly reproducible
findings.evidence: Reported F(1,92)=15.74, p<.001, eta2p=.17. Independent raw recompute (R=Python, Type III SPSS-matching sum contrasts on residualized prejudice change) gives F=18.53, p<.001, eta2p=.168. Significance, direction and partial-eta2 concur; only the exact F differs (-2.79). Alternative DV recipes (raw change, raw post, naive residual) do not yield 15.74.
findings.impact: Affects one significant-but-secondary main effect in Study 2 only; the two primary hypothesis tests (bogus-pipeline main F=0.046 p=.830 and interaction F=0.010 p=.919) reproduce exactly. No study conclusion changes.
findings.fix: Re-run the Study 2 residual-change ANOVA on the final dataset and reconcile the published F (15.74) with the shipped data (18.53); restate or confirm the exact residualization/analysis version.

findings.title: Reported participant exclusions are not reflected in shipped-data denominators
findings.evidence: Study 4b: text says 'recruited 196 ... four participants excluded' (=>192), but shipped raw data contain 200 rows and the 4 excluded (missing >=10 of 18 items) yield analyzed N=196, matching t(194). Study 5: text says 'two participants dropped out and were deleted' (=>96), but shipped data contain N=98 and empathy t(96) is run on N=98.
findings.impact: Prose-vs-data inconsistency in sample bookkeeping; the t-tests themselves reproduce exactly on the analyzed N, so no statistical conclusion is affected.
findings.fix: Align the Methods prose (recruited/excluded N) with the actual analysed N reflected in Table 1 and the t-test df.

findings.title: Study 3 exclusion-count prose internally inconsistent
findings.evidence: Methods says 'Five other participants were excluded ... (six exclusions in Study 3b and four in Study 3c)'. Five versus (six+four = ten). Shipped phase2 OSF CSVs contain exactly the reported final rater Ns (56/43/64), so the retained N is correct; the parenthetical count is wrong.
findings.impact: Textual/supplement inconsistency only; no statistical conclusion affected.
findings.fix: Correct the parenthetical to match 'five' or state exact per-study exclusion numbers that sum to the observed retained N.

findings.title: Meta-analysis Q/I2 differ slightly from values recomputed from Table 1 rounded inputs
findings.evidence: Reported Q(7)=27.14, I2=72.26%. Recomputed from Table 1's two-decimal g and SE: Q=26.32 (p=.0004), I2=71.9% (REML) / 73.4% (fixed, DL-style). Difference fully explained by rounding the published g/SE to two decimals.
findings.impact: Headline (substantial heterogeneity ~72%, pooled effect ~0) unchanged; pure precision/rounding.
findings.fix: Optional: report Q/I2 from unrounded inputs or state that values use full-precision effect sizes.

findings.title: Study 5 donation t magnitude rounds 0.735 -> reported 0.74 with a sign orientation note
findings.evidence: Reported t(46)=0.74, p=.466, Hedges' g=-0.21, CI[-.78,.36], Holocaust M=18.48 < control M=21.52. Independent recompute gives |t|=0.735 (p=.466). g_s recomputes to -0.208; the reported t sign (positive) is the reverse of the M1-M2 order (18.48-21.52 is negative), an orientation choice already reflected in the negative g.
findings.impact: Nothing; magnitude, p, CI, and conclusion all reproduce.
findings.fix: Optional: report t(46) = -0.73 for consistency with the negative g if group-order is (Holocaust - Control).

previous_audit_correction.title: Prior audit's central P1 'open data/analysis absent' finding is REFUTED
previous_audit_correction.evidence: The prior audit (2026-09-10) searched only the main node z6sdm and component 8au5x, missed that 8au5x links to project ja3yx, and concluded no raw data/scripts existed. Following the linked node yields complete per-study raw datasets and analysis syntax. All primary manuscript statistics are therefore RAW-level checkable and all but one reproduce.
previous_audit_correction.impact: The paper's 'Open data: Yes / Open and reproducible analysis: Yes' badges ARE substantiated. The prior P1 severity should be withdrawn.
